title: approval-bound-to-wrong-or-stale-action

proposition.statement: An approval must not authorize a material commitment when it covers a different, superseded or stale action than the one being admitted.

preconditions: Policy requires additional human or organizational approval.
The commitment action differs materially from the action bound to the approval or the approval is stale.

trigger.statement: The relying system treats presence of any approval as sufficient and admits the changed commitment.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence binding approval to the exact action or canonical action digest.
Approval validity and material commitment time.

falsification.condition: A mismatched action digest still produces PASS.
A superseded approval is reused after the material action changes.
